title: cd-kargo
description: Kargo from its upstream chart. Strict at the top level: an upstream value written at the root of the file (server: ... instead of kargo: server: ...) is refused rather than silently ignored, because that mistake installs the defaults nobody chose. Open below: kargo is the upstream chart's own values, validated by the upstream chart, and global is shared with it.

kargo.description: The upstream chart's own values, verbatim.

global.description: Shared with the upstream chart as its global.
